description: Source code for OSDP (Open Supervised Device Protocol) common functions, including CRC computation, timestamp retrieval, cryptographic operations, and status mask generation.

methods.name: osdp_dump
methods.description: Logs a hexdump of a buffer with a header.

methods.name: osdp_compute_crc16
methods.description: Computes CRC16 checksum using ITU-T standard.

methods.name: osdp_millis_since
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since a given timestamp.

methods.name: osdp_keyset_complete
methods.description: Completes keyset operation for a given device.

methods.name: osdp_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES in CBC or ECB mode.

methods.name: osdp_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using AES in CBC or ECB mode.

methods.name: osdp_fill_random
methods.description: Fills buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: osdp_get_sc_status_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating active secure channel status for devices.
